description: A SessionStart(compact) hook that nudges a compacted lead to run lead-revive before anything else, and the mailbox push mod (mailbox-push/register.ts): once the agent binds its session key through the mod's mailbox watch tool, arriving cross-session mail starts a turn even in an idle session. Claude Code auto-discovers this file by its hooks/hooks.json path; there is no plugin.json pointer to it (contrast the Codex adapter, whose manifest names its hooks file explicitly).
